page.overview:
Who is Harumi Hasashi?

Harumi Hasashi (Japanese: 波佐志 春美) also known by her 'pet' name Kana (Japanese: カナ) was the wife of Hanzo Hasashi and a victim of the Shirai Ryu massacre, along with her son, Satoshi. Despite her minor appearances in the franchise, she is pivotal to the character storyline of Hanzo Hasashi, as she is the reason for his resurrection as the Spectre Scorpion and the rivalry between Hanzo, Sub-Zero and the Lin Kuei, due to his lustful desire to avenge his family and clan.

In the current timeline, she is known as , in reference to the Shirai Ryu itself. She becomes the wife of Kuai Liang in this timeline, as he became the timeline's Scorpion, and in doing so, is the wife of the bearer of the "Scorpion" name once again.

Upon encountering Scorpion for the second time, Scorpion, now a Spectre, confronted Sub-Zero for destroying his clan and killing his family, and attempts to have his revenge. However, Sub-Zero was not directly responsible to their death.

Sometime after his return to the Netherrealm, Scorpion learned from Quan Chi that his wife and child had been slain by Kuai Liang, the younger Sub-Zero. After defeating Sub-Zero, Quan Chi showed up and told Scorpion that he was actually the one who murdered his family.
